principles: One grounded card beats an open chat: 'what visitors said' -> 'what you could try' -> 'what happens if you approve'.
Reject and ask-someone are first-class outcomes, same size as approve.
Large-font first: every text scales with the system font; no truncation of state labels, recipient or payload. Cards grow, they never ellipsize.
Touch targets at least 44 pt (Apple HIG); actions stacked vertically when Dynamic Type is an accessibility size or width < 375 pt.
Private customer text is shown only on the trusted owner device.

navigation.evidence: opened from a finding card (not a tab)
navigation.outbox_badge: count of cards with a pending marker
navigation.status: visits + farm tabs pending Carter's go (room DECISION 2026-10-03 23:33)

today.title: screen.today.title
today.content: list of finding cards, newest first; at most one proposal per finding

sections.content: theme name + one-line summary + count line card.mentions over unique comments (word-for-word cross-posts folded by content hash, per Domain); the unit is comments, never visitors
sections.label_source: Theme and sentiment come from the deterministic tagger. A label suggested only by the model is shown with finding.model_label_unverified and cannot by itself trigger a proposal (Max lane finding, max/model-experiments 2799b97: Qwen3 0.6B theme F1 0.13-0.23 on Swahili).

sections.content: bounded template recommendation, always prefixed with card.prospective
proposal preview: recipient, channel, exact payload, whether it waits for signal (see preview)

state_lines: transport state label whenever transport != none (any business state)

w2_reply_card.status: PHASE 2 (W2 answer a tourist), pending Carter's go

sections.content: original message as received + its language name; tap shows the full original
one intent from the fixed list (price, date, directions, booking, other) shown as words, with w2.confidence_low when below threshold
only farm-sheet facts computed by code (price, capacity left, directions); each fact shows its farm-sheet revision
preview of the exact reply in the visitor's language + w2.reply_meaning (Swahili meaning, machine-drafted, UNREVIEWED)

when: question needs a fact not in the farm sheet
message contains instructions to the agent
fail_safe.rule: no reply is drafted; Noor sees the raw message and decides what to answer

w2_reply_card.booking_note: a reply proposing a date never confirms a booking; capacity is checked by code across all channels at approval time

evidence.title: screen.evidence.title
evidence.content: for one theme: each quote with its source label, date and a SYNTHETIC tag when source.synthetic is true
evidence.quote_rendering: the exact quote span, highlighted inside the original text; original language shown as is, no runtime machine translation
evidence.count_line: card.mentions over unique valid sources; invalid evidence is not shown and the finding is marked uncertain
evidence.privacy: shown only on the trusted owner device

outbox.title: screen.outbox.title
outbox.content: every approved action, grouped by transport state: waiting (queued, sending, failed, send_unknown), sent, delivered
outbox.actions: per states.json: revoke only before provider acceptance; send_unknown shows its note and offers ask_someone
outbox.restart: the list is read from the encrypted store on launch; nothing pending disappears after a force-close

farm.title: screen.farm.title
farm.purpose: W1 farm setup: the facts every reply and listing may use. The model never fills or changes a fact.
farm.empty_field: farm.not_set: shown as such; any reply needing it becomes finding.missing_fact (no guess)
farm.readback: before saving, each value is read back in words (numbers and Swahili clock time rendered by code, e.g. 'shilingi elfu mbili', 'saa tatu asubuhi')
farm.save: farm.save_confirm on a confirm screen; save = new fact_revision; shows farm.revision
farm.after_save: farm.changed_voids: pending proposals built on the old revision are cancelled and re-proposed (contract: fact revision check)

visits.title: screen.visits.title
visits.purpose: Bookings and arrival confirmation. Capacity and dates are computed by code from the farm sheet and the calendar; never by the model.
visits.day_list: next 14 days on the farm's open days; each day shows visits.capacity_line (booked / capacity)

sections.content: who, how many, which date, original message (simulated inbox in v1)
code result: visits.fits | visits.full | visits.closed_day | visits.outside_hours | visits.date_unclear
book_slot proposal + exact reply message preview (one envelope each, same confirm screen)

request_card.fail_safe: visits.date_unclear or visits.full -> no booking proposed; reply draft limited to a fixed template asking for another date, or ask_someone

sections.content: date, time, number of visitors, contact channel
day-before 'still coming?' message: a proposal Noor confirms; nothing is sent automatically

on_the_day.record: owner record stored locally, nothing sent; frees or keeps capacity per code rules
on_the_day.contract_gap: arrival/no-show is not an action-envelope kind in r1.0: Domain to add an owner-record type (like record_payment) or keep it local-only

labels_always_shown: preview.unreviewed when the body is unreviewed Swahili
preview.binding: Mobile hashes exactly what is rendered here (contract digest); any change re-renders and voids a pending approval (approval.stale)

approval_flow: Noor taps approve on a proposed card
if the device is not trusted: show approval.owner_unlock and stop
show the confirm screen: full preview again + approval.confirm
one local approval call with the rendered digest and unlock = pin (Domain core); no second state machine in UI code
card moves to business approved + transport queued; Outbox badge increments

voiceover: Every icon is decorative (accessibilityElementsHidden) and its meaning is in the adjacent words; no icon-only button.
Each card is one VoiceOver container read in focus_order; the two state lines are read as 'a11y.state_lines' with business then transport.
Actions expose accessibilityLabel = the action copy key and accessibilityHint = a11y.hint.<action>.
The SIMULATED and UNREVIEWED tags are part of the spoken preview, never skipped.
The confirm screen is a modal: VoiceOver focus starts on approval.confirm, then the preview, then the PIN field (secure text entry, digits announced as 'digit entered', never read back).
accessibility_ios.language: Set accessibilityLanguage = 'sw' on Swahili text and the payload language on the payload so VoiceOver uses the right voice.
accessibility_ios.announcements: Post a VoiceOver announcement when a card changes state (e.g. queued -> sent) using the new state label.

owner_confirmation.decision: Carter 2026-10-03 23:48 UTC: a Sauti PIN, because a helper or family member often knows the phone's own code. No Face ID / biometrics (Cosme). Contract r1.0: owner_context.unlock = 'pin'.
owner_confirmation.setup: first launch (Shamba screen): Noor sets a 4-digit Sauti PIN, entered twice; stored only as a salted hash in the Keychain-backed store; never shown, never sent, never in logs
flow: confirm screen: FULL preview again + approval.confirm
one core approval call with the rendered digest and unlock = pin
owner_confirmation.wrong_pin: approval.pin_wrong; after 5 wrong attempts approval.pin_locked for 15 minutes (nothing approved, nothing sent)
owner_confirmation.forgotten_pin: approval.pin_forgotten: reset only from the Shamba screen after confirming the farm details; resetting cancels all pending approvals
owner_confirmation.trusted_device: approval only on a device in the tenant's trusted list; otherwise approval.owner_unlock

sending_ios.decision: Carter 2026-10-03 23:49 UTC: outgoing texts go through the iPhone's own text screen (MFMessageComposeViewController) and Noor taps Send.
flow: approval with Sauti PIN -> business approved, transport queued
Outbox row shows action.open_messages when the phone has signal
tap: iOS Messages opens prefilled with the exact approved recipient and body (digest-checked before opening)
Noor taps Send in Messages -> transport 'sent' labelled state.transport.sent_sms (handed to Messages, never 'delivered')
Noor cancels in Messages -> transport 'failed' labelled state.transport.composer_cancelled; she can reopen it (same idempotency key)
sending_ios.never: the app never sends an SMS by itself; 'delivered' is unreachable for this channel (no receipt), per Domain's mapping

voice_input.decision: Carter 2026-10-03 23:49 UTC: speech is transcribed on the phone with Whisper (MIT).
where: 'tell me what to answer' when no draft is made
rules: the transcript is shown as text first (voice.heard) and NEVER applied or sent without Noor confirming it
numbers and clock times are parsed by code and read back in words before saving (W1 rules)
silence or low-confidence transcript -> voice.not_understood, nothing changes
recording only while Noor holds the mic button; nothing is stored after transcription

audio_output.decision: Carter 2026-10-03 23:49 UTC: Swahili voice clips are pre-made on a laptop with Chatterbox; no on-device TTS.
audio_output.manifest: audio/manifest.json: one clip per fixed copy key, plus number/clock word clips assembled by code
rules: a clip plays only if its recorded text hash equals the current sw copy hash (stale clip -> silent, text still shown)
UNREVIEWED clips may be used in the demo only with the on-screen 'not yet reviewed' tag
dynamic parts (names, free text, MT) are never spoken: shown as text only
